## Checklist

- [ ] Changes to trigger or expression **semantics** include a test **and** cite a source (GitHub docs link or a reproduced real run).
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior, flags, or limitations changed (`README.md`, `docs/limitations.md`).
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
